name: Wellspring River
summary: The Wellspring River flows from a natural spring within Teldrassil, coursing north out of Wellspring Lake until it plummets off the boughs in a towering waterfall to the ocean far below. Once a peaceful source of fresh water for the World Tree's ecosystem, its banks have grown perilous due to agitated local wildlife.

sections.title: Waters of the World Tree
sections.body: Nourished by the deep natural springs nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil, the Wellspring River carries water north from Wellspring Lake across the verdant forest floor before cascading dramatically over the edge of the great tree down into the sea below. Despite the serene surroundings, the riverbanks are increasingly unsafe. The timberlings that dwell along the water have grown crazed and hostile, violently attacking travelers and druids who attempt to draw near the river's edge.

faq.q: Where does the Wellspring River lead?
faq.answer: The Wellspring River flows northward out of Wellspring Lake. Eventually, it reaches the rim of Teldrassil's canopy and plunges over the edge in an enormous waterfall that drops all the way down into the surrounding ocean.

faq.q: Why are the timberlings along the river attacking people?
faq.answer: The timberlings along the Wellspring River have become erratic and crazed, turning on anyone who wanders nearby. This aggression is part of a broader disturbance spreading through Teldrassil's natural wildlife, alarming the local night elven druids.

faq.q: Where does the water in the river come from?
aliases: where does wellspring water come from
faq.answer: The river is fed directly by Wellspring Lake, which itself is sustained by a natural freshwater spring rising deep from within the living trunk and boughs of the World Tree.

angles.text: The corrupted and maddened state of the river's native timberlings is an unsettling sign of the growing sickness creeping through Teldrassil's ecosystem.
The freshwater waterways flowing from the heart of Teldrassil represent the vitality of the Kaldorei's new home, making the unrest along their banks deeply concerning.
